versions.changelog:
- Initial release of the Crucible skill.
- Provides a fully configurable delivery pipeline: PM → UX → Dev → Test, with stage and gate controls.
- Each stage includes an implement → self-review → fix internal loop for quality convergence.
- Gates enforce cross-role checks with clearly defined pass/reject/leftover protocols.
- Supports parallel development in Stage 3 with strict API contract enforcement.
- Integrated guiding methodologies and references for each stage and gate.
